item.title: 4 local drug users camping in the bushes, 10th August
item.description:
At least 4 well-known drug users/homeless people are living in the bushes by the silver birch trees. They have made a path through the foliage to their campsite. There is detritus around them. It is close to the village hall, school/municipal football cage and the childrens' play area. This morning a dog wandered in there and the owner had to go and bring their dog out. They said it was disgusting and unsafe. This is in addition to the human waste issue around there and discarded drug paraphernalia. Specifically they are in the middle of the small hill in the centre of the park.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tyers Gate, The Borough, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
